summary.text: Sherri Reinfurt is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 29 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as the owner of Manchester Chiropractic & Sports Injuries, PLLC.

paragraphs.text: Sherri Reinfurt's career experience includes working as an owner of Manchester Chiropractic & Sports Injuries, PLLC, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.
She assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the general election ballot for Hillsborough 29.
